name: Connection probe (one tracker read per project, status row connection.<project>.status)

knobs.note: BH-7924: the time one project's probe (context + one tracker read) may take, read as ${CONNECTION_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S:-60} by bin/connection-probe.sh. A probe past it is written as ok:false "timed out after Ns". A value outside 5..300 is refused: one log line, nothing probed.

BH-7924: the cut of the scrubbed error text in connection.<project>.status, in bytes of its JSON encoding, read as ${CONNECTION_PROBE_ERROR_MAX:-300} by bin/connection-probe.sh. Any value in 40..1500 keeps the row under the worker's status bound (settings row connection.status_max_bytes, 2048..16384) with every var name. A value outside 40..1500 is refused: one log line, nothing probed.
BH-7924 test seam: epoch seconds checkedAt is taken from, read as ${CONNECTION_PROBE_NOW:-<date +%s>}. NOT settable from the control plane.
